description:
The Shramik Basera Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India to provide housing and shelter to the construction workers and laborers in urban areas. 

This scheme was launched in 2018 under the aegis of the Government of Bihar. 

The primary objective of the Shramik Basera Yojana is to ensure that construction workers have access to affordable housing. 

The scheme aims to provide temporary housing facilities to laborers who migrate to urban areas for work. 

The government has set a target to construct a total of 10,000 housing units under this scheme. 

These housing units are designed to provide basic amenities such as water supply, sanitation, and electricity. 

Each housing unit under the Shramik Basera Yojana is expected to accommodate a family of four. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is substantial. 

The government allocates a budget of ₹1 lakh for each housing unit constructed. 

This amount covers the cost of construction and basic amenities. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of providing a safe and secure living environment for laborers. 

Eligibility for the Shramik Basera Yojana is specifically defined. 

The primary beneficiaries of this scheme are construction workers and laborers. 

Applicants must be registered with the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BOCW). 

To be eligible, applicants must be at least 18 years of age. 

There is no upper age limit specified for eligibility. 

Income criteria are also established for the scheme. 

Eligible applicants must have an annual income of less than ₹3 lakh. 

This income limit ensures that the benefits reach the economically weaker sections of society. 

The application process for the Shramik Basera Yojana is straightforward. 

Interested applicants must fill out an application form available at the local BOCW offices. 

The application form requires basic personal details and proof of identity. 

Applicants must also provide proof of their employment as construction workers. 

Documents required include an Aadhar card, income certificate, and registration certificate with BOCW. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The verification process may take up to 30 days. 

After verification, eligible applicants are notified about the approval of their housing unit. 

The disbursement of funds for the construction of housing units is carried out in phases. 

The first installment of ₹50,000 is released upon approval of the application. 

The remaining ₹50,000 is disbursed after the completion of the housing unit. 

The timeline for the construction of housing units is typically set at six months from the date of fund disbursement. 

The implementing authority for the Shramik Basera Yojana is the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

The BOCW operates under the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India. 

Contact details for the BOCW can be found on their official website. 

The scheme has been positively received by the target beneficiaries. 

It addresses the critical issue of housing for laborers who often live in inadequate conditions. 

The provision of housing is expected to improve the quality of life for construction workers. 

Additionally, it aims to enhance their productivity by providing a stable living environment. 

The Shramik Basera Yojana is part of a broader initiative by the government to support laborers. 

It aligns with the government's commitment to social welfare and economic development. 

The scheme has also been linked to various skill development programs for construction workers. 

This ensures that beneficiaries not only receive housing but also opportunities for skill enhancement. 

The government has reported that over 5,000 housing units have been constructed under this scheme as of October 2023. 

This indicates a significant progress towards the target of 10,000 units. 

The Shramik Basera Yojana is crucial in the context of urban migration. 

With increasing urbanization, the demand for affordable housing is on the rise. 

The scheme plays a vital role in addressing this demand effectively. 

Moreover, it contributes to the overall economic growth by supporting the labor force. 

The government continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme closely. 

Regular assessments are conducted to ensure that the objectives are being met. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is also taken into account for future improvements. 

In conclusion, the Shramik Basera Yojana represents a significant effort by the Government of India. 

It aims to provide essential housing facilities to construction workers and laborers. 

The scheme not only addresses immediate housing needs but also contributes to long-term social welfare. 

By focusing on the needs of the labor force, the government is fostering inclusive growth. 

This initiative is a step towards ensuring that every worker has a safe and secure place to live. 

The Shramik Basera Yojana is a testament to the government's commitment to improving the lives of its citizens. 

It reflects a comprehensive approach to welfare that combines housing, safety, and economic support. 

As the scheme progresses, it is expected to have a lasting impact on the lives of many construction workers in India.
